verdict.rationale: The MCP authentication docs list a named permission scope (`context:protected:read`) for reading protected context. The hosted MCP sits behind an OAuth/RFC 9728 bearer-token wall with a separate authorization server, and the CLI uses device-code login. Together this suggests agent credentials carry scopes, but nothing shows a user choosing or issuing least-privilege credentials. missing for 10: documented user-facing issuance of scoped API keys/tokens, a full scope catalog and how to restrict an agent to a subset, revocation/expiry controls, hands-on verification of a scoped token.
